violations.description: General employee cleanliness. — --Food employee did not wash hands as necessary. Employee observed changing gloves between tasks without properly washing hands.

Preventing contamination during storage. — --Food item was not properly protected from potential contamination. Multiple open boxes and bags in the walk in freezer. Food must be covered to protect from contamination.

Preventing contamination from equipment, utensils, and wiping cloths. — --In-use utensil was not properly stored during pauses in food preparation or dispensing. A scoop was left inside a container of chicken breading leaving the handle in contact with food items.
Food-contact surfaces - Design and construction. — --Food contact surface was not disassembled for proper cleaning. Can opener blade has a buildup of food debris. In need of detail cleaning.

General equipment and utensils - Maintenance and operation. — --Nonfood contact equipment/utensil was not maintained in a good repair or sound condition. Throughout the kitchen and storage areas multiple countertops and shelves have exposed particle board and need to be sealed.

Cleaning frequency of equipment and utensils. — --Equipment that dispenses liquid/food/ice in unpackaged form was not cleaned properly and/or as frequently as required. Both soda machines had a buildup of syrup in the areas around the nozzles. All areas of the soda machine need to be cleaned more frequently.--Equipment that dispenses liquid/food/ice in unpackaged form was not cleaned properly and/or as frequently as required. The ice machine in the back has a buildup of debris on the splash guard. Needs detail cleaning.--Nonfood contact surface was not cleaned as frequently as required. The back reach in freezer, pizza prep cooler, and sandwich prep cooler all have excessive buildup of food debris. Detail cleaning needed.

Single-service and single-use articles. — --Single-service item was not stored in a proper location to be protected from contamination. Multiple single-service items near the pizza ovens are stored in a cardboard box that has a buildup of food debris. Single-service items need to be stored in a hard/durable container free of potential contaminants.
Linen storage. — --Dirty wash aprons are hung on the clean dish rack coming into contact with clean dishes.

Plumbing system. — --Plumbing system was not designed, constructed, operated and/or maintained according to regulation. Ice machine draining onto floor leaving standing water. Causing a buildup of debris under and around machine

Design and construction of floors, walls, and ceilings. — --Floors, walls, and/or ceiling were not constructed or designed to be smooth, nonabsorbent, and easily cleanable. In the back hallway of kitchen there is acoustic tile used throughout the ceiling. Ceiling tiles must be smooth, nonabsorbent, and easily cleanable.

Cleaning and maintenance of floors, walls and ceilings. — --Physical facilities (e.g. floors, walls, ceiling etc…) were not maintained in good repair. In several locations throughout the kitchen and storage floor tiles were damaged or missing. Leaving unsealed concrete exposed.

Cleaning frequency of equipment and utensils. — --Equipment that dispenses liquid/food/ice in unpackaged form was not cleaned properly and/or as frequently as required. - Ice machine in back area in need of cleaning. Splash guard/skirt dirty.

Cleaning and maintenance of floors, walls and ceilings. — --Physical facilities (e.g. floors, walls, ceiling etc…) were not clean or not cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. - Floors in back and prep areas in need of cleaning.
Design, construction, clean, maintained (1 pt deducted)
Available, adequate capacity, able to maintain proper temperature (4 pts deducted)
Hot holding and cold holding temperatures maintained, unwrapped food not reserved (5 pts deducted)
Method, clean, temp, concentration, exposure time, equipment/utensils sanitized (4 pts deducted)
Design, construction, clean, maintained (1 pt deducted)
Clean/dry location, protected, covered, original containers, labeled (2 pts deducted)
Date marking accomplished, discarded (2 pts deducted)
